source_text.supervisor: USER-PRIORITY Q-1037 / GH #2364 backend-gate speed: PR1 of sharding. test_parallel.sh gains TEST_PARALLEL_TOTAL/OFFSET/SHARD; mix.exs gains letflow.check.static; letflow.check.test gains --shard K/M and --tails-only. Inert in CI (ci.yml untouched). Commit locally only.

task.description: Diagnosis/design: ExUnit partitions files round-robin by rem(index,total)==partition-1 (Elixir mix/tasks/test.ex:1043-1047), so TOTAL=N*M with each shard running global partitions OFFSET+1..OFFSET+N tiles the suite. Ready-file pairing: test/test_helper.exs:121 writes partition-${MIX_TEST_PARTITION}.ready and the script polls partition-$idx.ready, so loop index must be global.
acceptance_criteria: sliced runs use global partition indices everywhere
bad inputs exit 1 with no partition launched

result.summary: Implemented in commits c5f5a498 (script) and f50c4191 (mix alias + task). Deviations from plan: letflow.check kept as one flat alias list (@check_static_steps ++ ["letflow.check.test"]) instead of nesting, because test/mix/tasks/letflow.check_boundaries_test.exs and letflow_check_deferral_staleness_test.exs index the flat list; unsliced output gets no slice suffix/line so default output is byte-identical.
